summary: Comprehensive software architecture and aerospace propulsion engineering plan for the ThrustWorks Dynetics 5 kN LOX/RP-1 Swirl Coaxial Injector Calculator. Covers frontend-to-OpenFOAM/Python bridging, the 4-stage workflow & dark-slate telemetry UI, OpenFOAM post-processing extraction (Mass Flow, Spray Cone Angle, VOF, and Live Residuals), and a multi-stage CFD validation strategy.
